item.title: Alabama football legends TELL ALL! Roman Harper, Damien Harris, & Zabien Brown from SEC MEDIA DAYS!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: Beat Everyone is in Tampa for SEC Media Days 2026. AL.com Alabama beat reporter and podcast correspondent Nick Kelly is back with three VERY special guests, all of them Crimson Tide legends! ESPN and SEC Network analyst Roman Harper, current Alabama defensive back Zabien Brown, and CBS Sports analyst Damien Harris all sit down with Nick to talk all things Bama, including thoughts on the 2026 season and stories from their playing days in crimson and white.

item.title: SEC Media Days 2026: Ryan Coleman-Williams, Bray Hubbard, & Josh Pate!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: It's Alabama Day at SEC Media Days in Tampa. Head coach Kalen DeBoer hit the podium to talk all things Crimson Tide. Beat Everyone correspondent Nick Kelly sat down with Bama stars Ryan Coleman-Williams and Bray Hubbard to look ahead to the 2026 season. Plus, Josh Pate joins Nick to talk the Tide's outlook this year, the quarterback battle, and much more!
